title: macOS Tahoe — Kimi K2.7
originalPrompt: Recreate the whole MacOs tahoe interface as a web app. Every app and menu should be working

questionsAndAnswers.question: What level of completeness are you actually looking for?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Core desktop + a few working apps

questionsAndAnswers.question: If you want working apps, which are the highest priority? (Pick up to 5)
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Finder (file manager), Safari (web browser), System Settings, Terminal, Calculator, Notes, Photos, Music, Mail, Messages

questionsAndAnswers.question: What technology stack do you prefer?
Do the apps need real backend functionality?
